tasks.description: Concatenates a source tree into a single context file, skipping files excluded by its ignore rules. Use when asked to bundle a source tree into one context file.
tasks.intent: Concatenate the app source tree into one context file honouring its ignore rules.

tasks.description: Writes a manifest of the files that go into a context bundle with sizes and line counts. Use when asked for a file manifest with sizes and line counts for a source tree.
tasks.intent: List bundled files with byte and line counts and per-extension totals.

tasks.description: Reports which files a source tree leaves out of its context bundle and the rule that excludes each. Use when asked which files are excluded from a context bundle and why.
tasks.intent: Report excluded files with the pattern or size rule that excludes each.
